title: Tabbing past the last visible control of a modal must wrap inside the modal even when it contains hidden buttons
summary: A modal with a display:none Try again button lets Tab escape from the last visible control to the page behind the modal.
consumer: Author-written report upload page around the unchanged upstream ES module source lib/src/index.js at buggyCommit.
splitNote: MicroModal #295 was used in earlier Tabstitch experiments (benchmarks/component-recovery), so it is not a holdout case.
